executionTarget: Copilot Studio new workflows with the GitHub Copilot harness
selectionRule: These are optional modules, not a fixed process. Choose zero, one, two or three for the customer goal.

commonContract.identity: Customer and legal-entity scope come from authenticated, authorized connections
commonContract.state: Persist invoice version, state, owner and correlation ID outside the conversation
commonContract.control: Enforce permissions, duplicate protection and approvals in the connected operation; a prompt is not authorization
commonContract.cost: Reuse existing structured data; select Azure extraction/storage only after comparing total customer cost
commonContract.humanReview: Every selected workflow can pause at REVIEW_REQUIRED. Assign an owner, obtain an authorized decision and revalidate before resuming. Do not require the entire approval workflow merely to provide an exception-review gate.
commonContract.unknownFinanceOutcome: Pause dependent actions and reconcile; a human decision does not authorize a blind retry

workflows.name: Capture and check
workflows.trigger: New invoice from a configured email, document library or upload
steps: Use structured fields or the selected extraction adapter
Run required and customer-selected validation modules
Pause unusual or uncertain invoices for an assigned human reviewer
Revalidate corrected data before creating a ready invoice
prerequisites: Extraction tool only for unstructured documents

workflows.name: Resolve and approve
workflows.goal: Reduce approval delays and follow-up work
workflows.trigger: A normalized invoice requires correction or approval
steps: Run the customer's routing and approval modules
Pause anomalies and let the agent explain the blocker when useful
Record authority and invoice version; invalidate approvals and revalidate after material changes
prerequisites: Normalized invoice from Capture and check OR the customer's existing process
workflows.valueMetric: Approval waiting time and follow-up touches

workflows.name: Register and track
workflows.goal: Reduce finance hand-off effort and make outcomes visible
workflows.trigger: An invoice is approved under the customer's policy
steps: Run preflight modules and block unresolved review cases
Invoke the selected Dynamics 365, SAP or other ERP adapter
Confirm the result; route unknown outcomes to reconciliation and human oversight
Run the configured archive step without repeating confirmed financial writes
prerequisites: Approved invoice from Resolve and approve OR an authorized existing process
Finance connection with unique reference and reliable outcome lookup
